context: Hiroshi-boss invites Ren to take a leading role on a new project.
purpose: Boss giving young employee growth opportunity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮くん、新しいプロジェクトを任せたい。
lines.en: Ren — I want to give you a new project.
lines.style: Measured opening. Slight pause before the offer—letting it land with weight. Warm but composed, the way a senior gives responsibility. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Genuine surprise, caught off-guard in the best way. Soft voice—almost to himself. The 'really' carries a small hopeful lift, then catches itself, grounding back to uncertainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: リーダーとして、頼んでみたい。
lines.en: I want to ask you to lead it.
lines.style: Calm, deliberate. The word 「leader」 lands with quiet emphasis—no drama, just clarity. Trusting without fanfare. Lean slightly forward in tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Quiet, almost thinking aloud. A moment of gravity—not complaint, but acknowledgment of weight. Breath caught slightly on the pause. Honest worry beneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Gentle firmness. Not an order—a benediction. Slight warmth underneath the brevity. The kind of thing a mentor says when they see something in you.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、全力で頑張ります。
lines.style: Breath drawn in at the opening. Commitment crystallizing into words. Quiet intensity—not shouting, but presence. A small nod forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 応援してるで、安心しろ。
lines.en: I'm rooting for you — rest easy.
lines.style: Warm closing. The first half reaches forward; the second half settles and reassures. Fatherly without being patronizing. A hand on the shoulder in tone.
